program_solutions:
(rule!
  (for/fold ([out g]) ([obj (in-list (objects g 0))])
    (if (empty? (filter (lambda (p)
                          (or (= (first p) 0) (= (first p) (- (rows g) 1))
                              (= (second p) 0) (= (second p) (- (cols g) 1))))
                        (obj-cells obj)))
        out
        (paint-cells out (obj-cells obj) 0))))
